name: Vonage
description: CPaaS provider with APIs for SMS/Messages (WhatsApp, RCS), Voice, Verify, Video, Numbers and Reports.
access_notes: Free self-serve signup issues an API key + secret immediately; new accounts get a small free trial credit (usage restricted to verified test numbers until a payment method is added). Usage is billed per-request/pay-as-you-go for production. JWTs (signed with a Vonage Application's private key) are required for webhook-capable APIs like Messages and Verify V2; key+secret can be sent Base64-encoded via Basic auth on newer APIs.
mcp_notes: Vonage ships two official MCP servers: a hosted Documentation MCP Server (documentation-mcp.vonage.dev/mcp) and the Server API Bindings MCP server (@vonage/vonage-mcp-server-api-bindings on npm) with tools for SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, voice, apps, and numbers. No Vonage toolkit found in the Composio toolkits catalog.
uncertainty_notes: Voice API also supports WebSocket media streaming, but the primary integration surface is REST + webhooks. Exact trial credit amount and test-number limits vary by region and were reported secondhand in search synthesis.

evidence.note: API key + secret created at signup; newer APIs take them Base64-encoded in the Authorization header; JWTs generated from application ID + private key; JWT recommended for Messages.
'sign up for an account. This will give you an API key and secret'; free credit at account opening, per-request billing; webhooks send data back to your server.
Free trial account; payment method optional for trial, required for production; API settings page manages keys, secrets, and signed webhooks.
Official Vonage docs page introducing the Documentation MCP Server and Server API Bindings MCP Server.
Official @vonage npm package: MCP tools for SMS, WhatsApp/RCS send, voice messages, application and number management.
